entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, may I have your name and order number?

Thank you, Sarah. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor 18 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a defect. The heart rate is completely wrong. This thing is basically garbage.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with the accuracy. I can transfer you to our technical support team. They have a few diagnostic steps that can often resolve this right over the phone.
No. I really **don't have time** to play IT guy for you. I tried it, it doesn't work, and I **just want money** back. Can you process a **refund** or not?
I understand your frustration, Sarah. Of course. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I've pulled up your order and our policy. It looks like you're well within the return window.
Our internal knowledge base shows a 90-day return period for all items. Since you received it 18 days ago, I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.
Fine. So you'll send me a label?

Yes, I'm generating a prepaid shipping label for you right now. It will be in your email in the next five minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
Great. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to the original form of payment within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Sarah. Have a good day.
